versions.name: Another batch of stat aggregation improvements

changes.change: Implemented unified stat pagination
changes.description: Merged all stat paginators into a single component. Leaderboards can now aggregate rating changes over every supported time period. Day and season stat widgets have been replaced with a universal AggregateStats widget.

changes.change: Added support for weekly and monthly stat aggregation
Adjusted decorator styles to match Dropdown component

commits.message: Merge stat paginators and aggregate stat widgets
Create Dropdown component and related test page
Implement per week and per month stat aggregation

commits.message: Add ability to zoom and pan charts

versions.name: Seasons, new stats and offline mode

changes.change: Added season system for organizing matches and statistics
changes.description: Matches and statistics can now be organized by seasons. Season specific statistics are available through the new SeasonPaginatorWidget and SeasonStats components. Elo and Glicko2 ratings are now also calculated on a per season basis.

changes.change: Added offline match storage with PWA support
changes.description: Matches can now be stored locally and synced when online. PWA support enables offline functionality with proper caching. Match hashes are calculated to prevent duplicate entries.

changes.change: Implemented toast notification system
changes.description: Added a toast notification system for displaying user feedback and important messages.

changes.change: Expanded player statistics tracking
changes.description: Added last match date, matches today, most matches in day, matches in season, most matches in season, and a detailed head-to-head statistics table showing performance against individual opponents.

changes.change: Expanded match statistics tracking
changes.description: Added tracking for ball outs, position changes, own goals, goals per minute, and time between goals (average, longest, shortest). Statistics widgets now display more detailed information.

changes.change: Reworked match statistics calculation flow
changes.description: Complete restructuring of how statistics are calculated and aggregated across matches, days, and seasons for better performance, ease of use and extensibility.

changes.change: Fixed Elo and Glicko2 team ratings calculation
Fixed player losses calculation
